title: Ready ● Set ● Knit: Projects
description:
Ready ● Set ● Knit: Projects is your guided helper for choosing what to knit next.

With a few simple questions, this Project Planner learns your confidence, your time, your machine, and your yarn situation - then suggests a project that fits you right now.

You'll get gentle guidance, clear next steps
excerpt: The shortest path to your next project
